evidence.reason: Left edit removes the metering.initialize() call, so subscriptionCharge no longer initializes metering before evaluating; this changes behavior relied on by the test asserting subscriptionCharge(40) > 0.
Right edit changes the default multiplier from configuration.rate to 0, altering the default charge calculation for callers that omit the multiplier argument.
chargeUnit is referenced by subscriptionCharge and references usageCharge, forming the dependency path that couples the two edits.
The test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 and usageQuote(30, 0.1, "monthly").amount > 0, exercising both edited symbols and the shared metering flow.
